name: Tachibana no Nagayasu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 69); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: The storms, which round Mount Mimuro
poems.author: Tachibana no Nagayasu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 69
poems.text:
The storms, which round Mount Mimuro
Are wont to howl and scream,
Have thickly scattered maple leaves
Upon Tatsuta’s stream;
Like red brocade they seem.

poems.title: 69. 嵐ふく 三室の山の もみぢ葉は (Arashi fuku Mimuro no yama no momijiba wa)
poems.author: Tachibana no Nagayasu
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後拾遺集
poems.text:
嵐ふく 三室の山の もみぢ葉は
龍田の川の 錦なりけり
